desc: MMTC Limited informs the exchange regarding clarification pertaining to Regulations 17(1), 18(1), 19(1)/19(2), 20(2)/(2A) & 21 (2) of SEBI (LODR) Regulations, 2015.

MMTC Limited has informed the exchange regarding the receipt of 458 requests of Re-lodgment of Transfer Requests of physical shares as per SEBI Circular No. HO/38/13/11(2)2026-MIRSD-POD/I/3750/2026 dated January 30,2026 for August 2026.
